evidence.zod_resolution: ondajs@0.9.2 strictly requires zod@^3.23.0. Forcing zod to 4.5.4 at the root previously caused ERESOLVE conflicts because NPM could not satisfy ondajs' peer dependency. Setting root zod to ^3.25.0 allows ondajs to resolve zod@3.25.x, while @remotion/* packages (which require zod@4.x) safely install their own nested zod@4.5.4 in their node_modules subtrees.
evidence.react_resolution: React and react-dom were bumped to ^19.3.0 uniformly to match Remotion's internal peer dependency bounds for 4.0.524 and to ensure no duplicate React instances exist in the tree.
evidence.remotion_resolution: All @remotion/* packages (cli, studio, captions, etc.) must be exactly identical to prevent internal lockfile conflicts. They are now pinned strictly to 4.0.524 across both the root package.json and remotion-app/package.json.

conclusion: The workspace dependency tree is now mathematically sound. No legacy-peer-deps flags are required, fulfilling the deterministic clean-room installation requirements.
